_comment: Per-file line budget for guard-service (scripts/file-budget.mjs, npm run lint:file-budget). A source file may have at most `limit` lines, a test file `testLimit`; a file listed under `files` was already over it and may not grow past its ceiling. Ceilings only come down: `node scripts/file-budget.mjs guard-service --update` lowers them after a split. Touch a budgeted file, split it. Adding a file or raising a ceiling is a deliberate edit that belongs in a commit message with a reason. `data` lists generated files, fixtures, templates and dictionaries whose length is content, each with a reason; they are skipped.
